What You'll Do Learn more about ADP at tech.adp.com/careers Key Responsibilities Assess Secure Web Gateway (SWG), next-generation firewall, URL filtering, SaaS inline, and related SSE controls against ADP policies and standards; identify configuration, coverage, and enforcement gaps. Govern access exceptions, allow/block lists, inspection exclusions, and rule lifecycle reviews, confirming business justification, least privilege, accountable ownership, expiration, and evidence of approval. Evaluate new platform capabilities and vendor limitations; define acceptance criteria and validate that deployed controls achieve the intended security outcome. Lead assessments of enterprise internet egress, including firewalls used as forward proxies, explicit proxies, PAC configurations, and alternate routes serving associates and server workloads. Deep practical expertise with Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Netskope, Broadcom/Symantec, Fortinet, or comparable firewall, proxy, or SSE platforms; ability to apply that experience to Prisma Access. Strong grounding of TCP/IP, routing, NAT, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS inspection, certificates, VPNs, endpoint connectivity, proxy architectures, and internet egress. Global Protect or comparable clients, explicit and transparent proxies, PAC files, and user-to-workload traffic flows. Working knowledge of DLP, CASB/SaaS discovery, IDS/IPS, malware prevention and sandboxing such as Wildfire, protective DNS, threat intelligence, WAF, and DDoS controls, including how these layers interact. Strong understanding of data security, encryption, privacy-by-design, and secure logging and monitoring practices. Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls). Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, coordinate urgent technical investigations, and balance tactical response with strategic improvement. Ability to turn incomplete or conflicting evidence into a clear technical hypothesis, a defensible recommendation, and a verified remediation outcome. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, emotional intelligence, disciplined follow-through, and close attention to technical and procedural detail.
